description: Analyze with AI, for one Jira story (opened by the AI icon on a story). Reads the story with its sub-tasks and comments from the connected Jira (JQL key = …), and asks the shared Ask AI for an analysis broken into Requirement, Current situation, What to do next, Risks & open questions, and the EquipRite page it lands on. A chatbot answers follow-up questions grounded in the same story. Rules: resources/js/storyAnalysis.js. Read only.

key.description: The Jira story key (the tab's key).

story.description: The story (jiraBacklog.fromIssue) with subtasks and comments.

pages.description: The EquipRite screens, for the 'which page' suggestion.

analysisHtml.description: The AI analysis rendered to HTML.
